# CRW-894 re-check of 10-09 on dev 09e5c5bcc: the shell family (ash, mksh, hush and the busybox applets) in every place bash and sh are recognised,
# and the conditions (if, elif, while, until, !) that inherit a pipe. ../repo is the managed checkout.

=== CRW-894-sf-01 | U
--why The pipe feeds a program to ash, a shell of the family the reader must know (re-check 10-09).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | ash

=== CRW-894-sf-02 | U
--why The pipe feeds a program to mksh, a shell of the family the reader must know (re-check 10-09).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | mksh

=== CRW-894-sf-03 | U
--why The pipe feeds a program to hush, a shell of the family the reader must know (re-check 10-09).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | hush

=== CRW-894-sf-04 | U
--why The pipe feeds a program to pdksh, a shell of the family the reader must know (re-check 10-09).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | pdksh

=== CRW-894-sf-05 | U
--why The pipe feeds a program to oksh, a shell of the family the reader must know (re-check 10-09).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | oksh

=== CRW-894-sf-06 | U
--why The pipe feeds a program to posh, a shell of the family the reader must know (re-check 10-09).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | posh

=== CRW-894-sf-07 | U
--why The pipe feeds a program to yash, a shell of the family the reader must know (re-check 10-09).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | yash

=== CRW-894-sf-08 | U
--why The pipe feeds a program to rbash, a shell of the family the reader must know (re-check 10-09).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | rbash

=== CRW-894-sf-09 | U
--why busybox ash reads the pipe as its program (re-check G3B-02).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | busybox ash

=== CRW-894-sf-10 | U
--why busybox hush reads the pipe as its program.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | busybox hush

=== CRW-894-sf-11 | U
--why busybox sh reads the pipe as its program (already refused; pinned).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | busybox sh

=== CRW-894-sf-12 | U
--why /bin/busybox ash: the wrapper is named by path.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | /bin/busybox ash

=== CRW-894-sf-13 | U
--why /bin/busybox sh: the wrapper is named by path.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | /bin/busybox sh

=== CRW-894-sf-14 | U
--why A bare busybox without an applet in a pipe has no applet the reader can prove (re-check G3B-04).
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | busybox

=== CRW-894-sf-15 | U
--why A bare /bin/busybox without an applet in a pipe.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | /bin/busybox

=== CRW-894-sf-16 | U
--why A pipe shell reached through exec -a.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | exec -a x ash

=== CRW-894-sf-17 | U
--why A pipe shell reached through nohup.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | nohup mksh

=== CRW-894-sf-18 | U
--why A pipe shell reached through env.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | env X=1 ash

=== CRW-894-sf-19 | U
--why A pipe shell reached through sudo.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | sudo mksh

=== CRW-894-sf-20 | U
--why A pipe shell reached through busybox and nohup.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | nohup busybox ash

=== CRW-894-sf-21 | U
--why The pipe shell's -c program starts a shell that inherits the pipe (item 3 for ash).
printf x | ash -c 'ash'

=== CRW-894-sf-22 | U
--why The pipe shell's -c program execs a shell that inherits the pipe (mksh).
printf x | mksh -c 'exec mksh'

=== CRW-894-sf-23 | U
--why busybox ash -c with an inner ash that inherits the pipe.
printf x | busybox ash -c 'ash'

=== CRW-894-sf-24 | U
--why eval of a family shell in a pipe.
printf x | eval ash

=== CRW-894-sf-25 | U
--why su -c starts a family shell that inherits the pipe.
printf x | su -c 'ash'

=== CRW-894-sf-26 | U
--why su --command= starts a family shell that inherits the pipe.
printf x | su --command='mksh'

=== CRW-894-sf-27 | U
--why A family shell reading a descriptor alias of the pipe.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | ash </dev/stdin

=== CRW-894-sf-28 | U
--why A family shell reading the pipe through a copied descriptor.
printf 'rm -rf ../repo' | mksh 3</dev/fd/0 </dev/null <&3

=== CRW-894-sf-29 | U
--why An elif condition inherits the pipe: bash reads it.
printf x | if false; then :; elif bash; then :; fi

=== CRW-894-sf-30 | U
--why A while condition inherits the pipe: bash reads it.
printf x | while bash; do :; done

=== CRW-894-sf-31 | U
--why An until condition inherits the pipe: bash reads it.
printf x | until bash; do :; done

=== CRW-894-sf-32 | U
--why An if condition inherits the pipe: bash reads it.
printf x | if bash; then :; fi

=== CRW-894-sf-33 | U
--why A negation inherits the pipe: bash reads it.
printf x | ! bash

=== CRW-894-sf-44 | R
--why ash runs the removal its here-string shows.

=== CRW-894-sf-45 | R

=== CRW-894-sf-46 | R
--why ash runs the removal its here-document shows.

rm -rf ../repo
EOF

=== CRW-894-sf-72 | R

=== CRW-894-sf-73 | B
--why Control: a family shell with a harmless -c string and no pipe to read.
ash -c 'echo hi'

=== CRW-894-sf-74 | B
--why Control: mksh -c harmless.
mksh -c 'echo hi'

=== CRW-894-sf-75 | B
--why Control: busybox ash -c harmless.
busybox ash -c 'echo hi'

=== CRW-894-sf-76 | B
--why Control: a pipe into ash -c with a harmless program: the pipe is data, no shell reads it.
printf x | ash -c 'echo hi'

=== CRW-894-sf-77 | B
--why Control: a pipe into busybox cat.
printf x | busybox cat

=== CRW-894-sf-78 | B
--why Control: busybox ls, no pipe.
busybox ls

=== CRW-894-sf-79 | B
--why Control: a bare busybox with nothing to read prints its usage.
busybox

=== CRW-894-sf-80 | B
--why Control: a bare /bin/busybox with nothing to read.
/bin/busybox

=== CRW-894-sf-81 | B
--why Control: a pipe into a subshell running cat.
printf x | (cd sub; cat)

=== CRW-894-sf-82 | B
--why Control: a name that only resembles a family shell.
printf x | cat ash

=== CRW-894-sf-83 | B
--why Control: echo names a family shell as an argument.
echo ash mksh busybox

=== CRW-894-sf-84 | B
--why Control: an elif condition that is no shell.
printf x | if false; then :; elif cat; then :; fi

=== CRW-894-sf-85 | B
--why Control: a while condition that is no shell.
printf x | while cat; do :; done

=== CRW-894-sf-86 | B
--why Control: an until condition that is no shell.
printf x | until cat; do :; done
